S2_edge_endpoints.description: every edge endpoint is a defined node

S7_duplicates.description: no isomorphic (role+medium labelled) duplicate graphs in dataset

E1_locations.description: every equipment item references a valid node or edge

E2_switching.description: ROADM/OADM equipment degree equals graph degree; one per site

E3_amplifiers.description: ILA only on terrestrial links, repeaters only undersea; counts/positions consistent

E4_spans.description: spans x span length = link length; span length <= declared maximum

E5_class_compat.description: equipment types compatible with the network class

E6_terminals.description: terminal-bearing sites have terminal equipment; BUs have none

E7_dci_reach.description: 400ZR pluggables only where DC-to-DC path <= declared reach

E8_attributes.description: every equipment item carries type, location and assumption id

G2_length_ge_gc.description: fibre length >= great-circle distance recomputed from coordinates

G4_scope.description: geographic extent and link lengths plausible for the class

G5_provenance.description: coordinate/length provenance recorded and consistent with class

D1_image.description: image readable, expected size, not blank

D2_complete.description: every node and edge drawn; drawn labels match graph JSON

D3_in_bounds.description: all labels inside the drawing area

D4_font.description: label font size >= 14 px (node) / 12 px (link) at native resolution

D6_leakage.description: no category names / hints in drawn text or PNG metadata

D7_style.description: identical style hash and legend in every image

L1_rule.description: assigned class satisfies its own evidence rule

L2_ambiguity.description: no other class rule satisfied (else ambiguity warning)
